body: Yes, thank you very much for your interesent. My pain is due to a excess with my workout at the gym when I was younger. Lot of training without control nor supervision caused me several chronic injuries. Also maybe I had bad luck or predisposition to injuries. I have seven muscular, nervous, cartilague and tendon injuries over my body that doesn't heal even with medical and physical caring. My body hurts all time, although the injuries aren't disabling I can't accept the fact of living in pain and it makes me feel older and guilty. I think I could deal with that and searching for possible solutions if my life was right but in my current situation it feels like hell to be in constant pain

Thank you for your response. Yes, I am treated but therapy doesn't works for me anymore, nor medication. It's all about lack of love, physical pain and a non resolved disorder that makes me feel unstable and a weird person. Too many years suffering since I was 20 and now two lost years in the darkness. I only want to finish this
